name: SRD creature Conditions (D&D 2024)
description: Closed creature-owned D&D 2024 Condition instances in canonical order. Fourteen non-Exhaustion Conditions may retain optional source-entity identity; one source-free Exhaustion entry carries level 1–6. Derived effects, durations, causes, death state, and history are separate owners. Governed by dnd2024.procedure.mechanic.conditions.
